title: Can Occupational Therapy be beneficial for my child who rejects affection?
metaTitle: Promoting Affection Acceptance through Occupational Therapy at Pinnacle Blooms Network
description: Learn about how Occupational Therapy at Pinnacle Blooms Network can help children with autism who may have difficulties accepting affection, fostering a warm and nurturing environment for them.
html: Definitely! At Pinnacle Blooms Network, we understand that affection can be processed differently by children with autism and can seem overwhelming to them. Our occupational therapists use gentle approaches to address potential sensory issues, teaching children to communicate their comfort levels and gradually exposing them to social touch through therapy sessions. Our goal is to help them feel secure in expressing and receiving love in their own unique way.
